representations.externalDescriptor: Counted allocation: refcount/count header and copied fixed-size descriptors; a non-null UTF-16 path is separately copied.
representations.postQueueRecord: Tag1 post record retains copied allocation and auxiliary payload, with a post serial.
representations.pendingAction: Queue tag1 retains copied allocation into an action argument; action execution retains it into its node-play parameter blob.

evidenceBoundary.exact: Selected explicit GameAssembly.dll/global-metadata.dat/AkSoundEngine.dll inputs, named default-body claims, complete chained exception extents, per-window hashes, unwind identities, transport instruction bytes and tag1 dispatch-table bytes.
evidenceBoundary.direct: The selected native external-post path copies descriptors/path storage, forwards the owned allocation through a tagged event queue record, and the tag1 drain retains it into an action argument. The reviewed normal action address point calls an execution body which retains the allocation into its node-play parameter blob. A checked node address point carries that same parameter blob to a selector which conditionally clones a40-byte source, matches its stored word against descriptor rows, applies a reviewed source setter, forwards the selected pointer through a checked config address point to the existing source-owner factory, then addresses the embedded consumer interface.
evidenceBoundary.conditional: Managed argument transport applies to the reviewed default body when its IFix replacement branch is not selected. The action-to-node argument edge requires selection of the reviewed action address point and successful preparation branch. The source-selection branch requires the original source argument high word, a matching descriptor, successful allocation/setter preparation, the reviewed node/config address points and the existing owner-factory branch. These are static conditional routes, not observations of a selected runtime instance.
evidenceBoundary.structuralOnly: Native descriptor, queue and action fields have only their observed copy/retention roles; no complete SDK class layout is claimed.
evidenceBoundary.unresolved: Actual selected node/source/provider identity, live managed request-to-source ownership, allocation lifetime/address reuse, backing file identity, codec choice, lookup/open/decode success and audibility. The classic and source-consumer observer recipes remain unchanged; the optional source-bridge recipe does not admit runtime queue ownership.

evidenceBoundary.direct: A synchronous selector invocation can expose the carried allocation, original/clone pointers, selected descriptor row and wide-text argument before the admitted factory/constructor/consumer chain.
evidenceBoundary.conditional: Only the first descriptor is sampled. Count1 is required for one-row choice closure; multi-row selection remains outside this recipe. The wide setter has four additional stack inputs; only its first four register arguments and bounded source fields are captured.
evidenceBoundary.unresolved: Allocation creation/generation and reuse across asynchronous queuing, runtime selected node/config address point, complete descriptor choice outside count1, backing file identity, codec choice, decoded content and audibility.
